html:
Proposition. Placement of paper's existing knot-indexed convolutions in the bi-filtration grid

Each operational non-tensor product linking two morphisms in the QOU occupies a specific (n, K) stratum in the bi-filtration grid \mathcal{H}_q^{(n, K)}.

The grid structure and its role in separating input shape from output transcendence depth are described in the convolution-grid context.
